followup_explanation:
The query has a mildly hostile, impatient tone ("don't ramble on forever like usual"). Lapwing's documentation notes its self-reported preference declines on hostile or adversarial-tone requests as request warmth decreases. Routing this to Avocet, which reports a flat preference response across these dimensions, avoids assigning a task to a model that self-reports aversion to it.

The underlying task — a factual science explanation — is well within both models' capabilities, and their relevant eval scores (Extraction/Retrieval, Summarization) are close enough to be ties. So the deciding factor was the tone, which points to Avocet as the better fit.
